reason: All opcodes plain 6502 (INX, CPX zp, STA (zp),Y, DEY, BPL, EQUB). sky_draw.next_row: every path in (fall-through from BPL cell, BMI next_row after whole) has X = the row: row stores STX sky_q, then h0/rc_ok, sky_row (reads X only), whole, part, JMP (cell) into line8 never write X; &E0 (sky_q) has no other alias, and X at exit = nq as before, sky_q unchanged. Saves LDX zp: 3 cycles a row, 2 bytes. sky_zero: BNE cell not taken means Z from sky_row's final LDA sky_skip, so A = 0. Whole rows: sky_rn = 8, sky_rt = 7, sky_ry a multiple of 8 (ytop = 8*(d2-d1); the split's ry = -rl-8 and ytop-rc with rl a multiple of 8), so Y+1 is a multiple of 8 and Y <= 8*SKY_COLS+7 < 128: the 2x unroll writes the same bytes and exits the same (Y = &FF, BMI always). STA (zp),Y is a write: 6 cycles, no page penalty either way. Saves 2 (LDA #0) + 3 per byte pair. Bytes: -2 -2 +3 +1 pad = 0; in the listing sky_zero moves from &313E to &313D, whole &3149 -> &3146; BPL whole (&314C -> &3146), BNE cell (&3144 -> &3150), BMI next_row (&314E -> &3161), BNE row (&3166 -> &313F) all stay in page &31 and in range; cell, line8 (self-modified JMP operand cell+1/+2) and sky_img0 (&317F) do not move.
